architecture_contract.common_input: frozen W72 local-decoder hidden at a UTF-8 scalar boundary plus the exact target first-byte argmax in EA..ED
architecture_contract.eligibility: target first-byte argmax is one of EA, EB, EC, ED; every proposal must encode a valid precomposed Hangul syllable with that same lead

proposal_heads.generic_independent_utf8: shared 196-to-128 GELU trunk and independent 64-way b2/b3 heads; valid Hangul same-lead candidates are scored by the sum
proposal_heads.generic_joint_utf8: 196-to-9 GELU low-rank trunk and a joint 4096-way continuation-pair head; valid Hangul same-lead candidates only
proposal_heads.hangul_conditional_components: 196-to-128 GELU state, onset top-4 beam, vowel conditioned on onset, coda conditioned on onset and vowel, with exact same-lead Hangul masks
proposal_heads.hangul_parallel_components: 196-to-160 GELU trunk and parallel 19/21/28 component heads; valid same-lead Hangul candidates are scored by the sum

architecture_contract.target_authority: the draft never replaces target logits; this preflight compares its two continuation bytes with exact sequential frozen-target greedy bytes
architecture_contract.teacher_forced_hidden_equivalence: BltModel.last_hidden_state followed by the frozen lm_head was mechanically verified bitwise equal to BltForCausalLM.logits before sealing; no quality statistic entered the plan

calibration_free_generation.prompt_selection: domain-separated SHA-256 bottom order over calibration-only valid 128-byte, scalar-boundary, Hangul-heavy windows; greedy non-overlap; no model output or metric input
calibration_free_generation.target_decoding: strict-UTF8-masked greedy W72 with sequential incremental cache

decision_rule.hangul_specificity_comparison: hangul_conditional_components minus generic_joint_utf8 complete-pair acceptance, paired by calibration prompt and pooled within prompt over three head seeds
decision_rule.pass_authorizes: exact target block verifier prototype only
decision_rule.primary_hangul_pass: Hangul conditional system feasibility passes, absolute complete-pair gain over generic joint is at least 0.01, and paired prompt-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound is greater than zero
decision_rule.stop_rule: if neither Hangul conditional nor generic joint passes system feasibility, stop the multi-byte draft branch

isolated_latency.includes: head proposal, valid-Hangul same-lead scoring/beam, output scalar readback, and MPS synchronization
